body: Per-FO Attention (0-1000). AddDogActivity: perDog*n^1.3 superlinear gain. Tick decay at BaseDecayRate. Thresholds: AUDIT_THRESHOLD (700) → OVERSIGHT_SECT summon; VENDOR_THRESHOLD (900) → SHADOW_OPERATOR summon. Clear events on decay below threshold. EcosystemEffects: migrationWeight, AHTaxMultiplier, ContestScaler. Registry: GetOrCreate/Get/TickAll/TotalAttention. 18 tests pass.
title: S119-03: server/attention — Attention meter system
